name: Tavily MCP server
summary: Tavily's hosted MCP server at mcp.tavily.com/mcp/ gives an agent search, extract, crawl, map and research tools over the Tavily API. The vendor documents a keyless mode selected by one request header, and on 2026-10-19 it held: without the header initialize answered 401 with an OAuth challenge; with it initialize and tools/list answered 200 with no account, listing five tools where the vendor's keyless page says two endpoints are keyless. The direct API answered a keyless search with the header and 401 without; the vendor's x402 endpoint answered 402 with a USDC price, as its page documents.
license: MIT (repository); hosted under Tavily's platform terms

agentAccess.notes: Keyless 2026-10-19 with the vendor's documented header X-Tavily-Access-Mode: keyless: initialize 200, tools/list 200 (five tools), one direct-API search 200. Without the header: 401 with a challenge naming the host's own OAuth issuer; an API key is the other path. Rate-limited, limits unstated.

payments.notes: 2026-10-19: no 402 from the MCP server keyless; x402.tavily.com/search answered 402, x402 v2, USDC on Base at 10000 units ($0.01 a call, as documented) beside an undocumented agent-pay entry at $0.016. Free key 1,000 credits a month, no card; plans from $30 a month; $0.008 a credit PAYG.
